title: SG 94 13 03 Sweet Potato (UPL Sp 12): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: SG 94 13 03 Sweet Potato: Yield and Maturity
metaDescription: SG 94 13 03 sweet potato is a sweet potato variety. About 120 days to harvest, 15.9 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: SG 94 13 03 is a registered sweet potato variety, also sold or known as UPL Sp 12. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2000 as NSIC 2000 Sp 22. It takes about 120 days from planting to harvest, with 15.9 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about SG 94 13 03 sweet potato
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

SG 94 13 03 sweet potato takes about 120 days from planting to harvest. That is 5.5 days longer than the average of the 26 sweet potato varieties with a day count, 114.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 15.9 t/ha beats the average of its group, 15.15. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit sweet potato fields most often: [root knot nematode](/diseases/root-knot-nematode). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its roots have yellow flesh and cream skin. Dry matter is 29 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 22.5 percent.
Where and when to plant SG 94 13 03 sweet potato

It is recommended for anywhere in the country. Pick by use and market: yellow or orange flesh for snacks and fries, purple for processing, white for boiling. Weevils are the main enemy, so plant clean cuttings and harvest on time.

items.q: Is UPL Sp 12 the same as SG 94 13 03?
items.a: Yes. UPL Sp 12 is another name for SG 94 13 03, registered as NSIC 2000 Sp 22. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 120 days from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 15.9 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
It is recommended for anywhere in the country. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of SG 94 13 03?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
